subject: E-Commerce
title: Triangulation Fraud
description: A quick, practical guide to Triangulation Fraud.

hook.text: A scammer lists a real product cheaply on a marketplace. When you buy, they use stolen cards at a real store.

buildup.text: You get a real product delivered. The real store gets a chargeback later. You had no idea a stolen card was used.

discovery.text: Triangulation fraud creates three victims: the real store, the card owner, and the marketplace's reputation.

twist.text: The scammer keeps your payment as pure profit. They never touch the product—it ships directly from the real store.

climax.text: Triangulation fraud is nearly invisible to buyers. You got an authentic product at a great price—everyone else paid.

punchline.text: Real product, stolen funding. Triangulation fraud hides behind happy customers.

quiz.question: How does triangulation fraud work?
options: Scammer fills customer orders using stolen credit cards at real stores
